tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gdan sa bar pa dge sding 'dra 'dri chos rdzong bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi chos sde bstan pa'i lhun po'i bca' yig bsam don kun 'grub bzhugs// bhaṭ+ṭa ra ka dharmā swa mi gu ru badz+ra dha ra ye na maḥ spangs rtogs mthar phyin rkang gnyis gtso bo zas gtsang sras/ /gang gi gsung mchog lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin mkhas dang grub pa'i dge 'dun tshogs/ /kun la deng nas byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan pa'i lam/ /thos dang bsam dang bshad sgrub sgo nas rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can khrod 'dir mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /grub dbang mchog dang sgra bsgyur lo tsā che rnams rgyal/ /khyad par kun mkhyen dga' bzhi brnyes pa snying po'i zhabs/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rtse mo mthar son dang / /ting 'dzin gter mnga' grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya'i bla chen yab sras rgyal/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bslangs mdzad zhabs/ /blo gros mi zad chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs mkhas dang / /gzhan yang lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /rim par byon pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad rgyal/ /lhag par snyigs dus bstan pa'i me ro gso ba la/ /bsam bzhin gzhan ngor skye ba bzhes pa'i sngags 'chang rje/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi/ /ngo mtshar rnam thar gang la bsams kyang snying nas 'dud/ /de sras thu bo pad+ma'i rnam sprul bsod nams dbang / /bo dhi sa twa sngags 'chang tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang ngur smrig gos 'chang mus pa rje/ /'brel tshad don ldan bla ma gsum gyis bdag skyongs shig /de ltar dge legs kun 'byung bla ma dang / /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel chos skyong srung ma yis/

/phyogs 'dir 'phral dang yun du dge legs stsol/ /ces mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir gdan sa bar pa dge sding 'dra 'dri chos rdzong bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi chos sde bstan pa'i lhun po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus bri bar bya'o/ /de la spyir sems can gyi bde skyid sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las/ dge 'dun gyi sde bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la rag las par bshad cing / de lta bu'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rtsod pa dang bral ba sngon byon pa dag gis legs par btab pa'i dgon gnas chos grwa 'di rnams deng sang gi bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog dag gis gces spras su bgyis na 'gro ba thams cad kyi srid pa dang zhi ba'i phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa'i gzhir 'gyur bar bshad pa 'di ni nges pa'i don dang ldan pa yin te/ deng sang gi dus kyi bstan 'dzin du khas 'che ba dag de lta bu'i bstan pa'i bya ba la gus pa dang rtag pa'i sbyor bas 'phral dang yun du 'bad par rigs te/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ ci'i phyir zhe na rgyal ba yi/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni/ /rtag tu 'tshe ba mang zhes gsungs/ /'di la soms la mkhas rnams kyis/ /rtag tu bstan pa'i byi dor bya/ /nyi ma gcig gi bza' btung la'ang / /bzang ngan rtog dpyod sna tshogs gtong / /gos dang mkhar las la sogs pa/ /bya ba gang la'ang legs nyes dang / /bzang ngan mkhas dang mi mkhas zhes/ /blang dor rtog dpyod sna tshogs byed/ /rta dang nor bu la sogs pa/ /cung zad tsam gyi nyo 'tshong la'ang / /kun la 'dri zhing brtags nas spyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang / /de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong / /skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ /dam pa'i chos la rag las kyang / /chos 'di khyi yi zas bzhin du/

/bzang ngan gang du'ang mi dpyod pa/ /gang 'phrad de la gus par 'dzin/ /nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma 'am/ /tshe gcig gi ni nye 'brel la'ang / /'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong / /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don/ /zhes pa nas/ kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar/ /'bad mi dgos par 'bad par byed/ /'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni/ /ci yang rung bas tshim par snang / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na da res skabs su babs pa dpal ldan sa skya'i gzhis dga' khyad par can dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas gdan sa bar pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos sku'i bkod pa drug tu bstan pa'i gcig shab sgo lnga gzhung 'bru'i bang mdzod gnas su bstan nas/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa snang zhing ngo mtshar gyi gtam du ma dang ldan pa sa skya pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa du mas zhabs zung mngon par bkod de byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen bsgom tshang bcu gsum gyi gtsug lag khang bzhugs pa/ sa lo chen po dang / bka' srung rnams kyis lung bstan pa bzhin mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis gsar du 'debs par mdzad pa la/ dus phyis bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa dbang po'i mtshan can de nyid kyis nyams gso gong 'phel du mdzad pa'i rgyun kho bo cag gis kyang mchog tu dar rgyas su bgyis pa'i dge sding 'dra 'dri chos rdzong bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi chos sde bstan pa'i lhun po 'di nyid thog mar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos gsar 'debs gnang ba nas bzung / da lta'i bar du der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis bstan pa'i bya ba thos bsam sgom gsum dang / mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la rtse gcig tu bgyis pa la brten nas/

spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gyur te byang phyogs kyi brgyud 'di rdzogs ldan ltar bde bas khyab pa de yin na'ang / deng sang gi dus 'dir bstan pa mar 'grib la thug pas dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dgon gnas che phra phal cher gyi bca' khrims rnams lo re bzhin lhod par 'gyur ba zhig 'dug pa nas/ 'dir bzhugs kyi dge 'dun la yang 'khrul zad gong ma rnams kyis bcas pa'i bka' khrims kyi rgyun bzang po mtha' dag mi nyams pa'i phyir gsal 'debs kyi tshul gyis cung zad brjod na/ 'dir bzhugs kyi 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams 'phral dang yun du gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa'i steng / thos bsam gyis rgyud phyug par byas nas zab mo'i don nyams su len pa la rtse gcig tu mdzad 'tshal te/ de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las mang du gsungs pas/ bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba las gsungs pa ltar gyi rab chos gos rnam gsum/ min na'ang 'dul ba yul chos dang bstun gsungs pa ltar/ ring 'gag rngul gzan/ thang sham/ rtse zhwa/ gding ba/ zla gam rnams tshang 'grig 'byor ba byas tshogs la 'du dgos pa yin zhing / zhwa gding tsam med na brgya phyag dang / thang sham sogs med cing / stod rjen/ rdo bem/ 'bob zon/ 'bar zhwa gyon pa byung na tshogs la rtsa ba nas 'dur mi 'jug rtsis med kyis 'dus pa byung na/ las tshan rnams mgrin gcig ngo lkog med par mar zho re blangs nas dkar mer 'bul/ de lta bu'i phyi'i kun spyod rnam par dag pa las ma g.yos pa'i ngos/ nang gi bslab pa 'dul ba sum brgya par/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang / /mi tshangs spyod rdzun bcos ma'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang / /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spangs/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge tshul dge slong gi bslab bya'i gtso bo rags rdog bcur 'dus/ de'i yang rtsa ba bzhi la yan lag rnams tshang na sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong bas/ 'chab sems kyis ma gos par byas la bskyar nas len/ lhag ma drug la yan lag rnams tshang na bshags bya'i nyes byas su 'gyur bar bshad pas/ rang sems dpang por bzhag pa'i bshags sdom gyi rtsis zin par byed/ lhag par bslab pa thams cad bag med par byed pa'i gzhi nyes pa ma lus pa skyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba ni chang yin te/ mdo las/ chang ni rtswa'i mchog mas kyang mi bslud mi 'thung ngo / /zhes gsungs pas/ chos byed rnams kyis dug can gyi zas ltar spang bya'i gtso bor bshad kyang / deng sang ni bstan pa nyams su 'dod pas dkor gyis myos shing nag phyogs kyis rgyud slad pa'i ngan pa dag lhan cig tu 'dus nas chang la bag med du spyod cing / rang re nang gtsang yin pas 'di tsam gyis ci skyon gzhan la gzab pa'i zer ba 'di 'dra'i rigs shin tu mang bar gda' ste/ sdom ldan rnams kyis myos 'gyur bag med 'thung ba lta ci smos/ cung zad tsam gyis kyang dmyal ba'i gnas su skyes nas khro chu khol ma dbang med du 'thung dgos par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs shing / sangs rgyas la rdzun ga la mnga' ste/ 'bras med phyir na rdzun mi gsungs/ /zhes bshad pa ltar yin la/ des na dmyal bar 'gro ba'i nang gtsang la/ dgos pa e 'dug sems yod rnams legs par soms dang / des na da phyin chad chang bag med 'grims pa lta ci smos/ dgon pa'i khrod du chang tshod long 'grims pa byung na/ bla ma spyi chos rnams mgrin gcig pas mar zho re 'gel/ gzhan chang mang nyung la spags 'gel lugs byas 'jam tshugs la 'debs/ nag mo'i cha/ ma bu yin nges kyis bu nad drag pos bzung ba lta bu'i mi 'dod pa byung ba'i tshan dang bla ma dang chos sde la zhabs tog zhu mi mthun grub rnams ma gtogs/

dgon khrod du bud med 'grims pa byung na mar zho do re 'gel/ nged rang gi chos gzhis khongs sogs su cho ga dang / rkyen bzlog sogs la grwa pa 'byon dgos byung tshe/ bla ma spyi chos rnams la dgongs grol zhus rjes bzhi sde longs na ma gtogs grong gseb tu zhag sdod mi byed/ 'gal ba byung na mar zho do re 'gel lugs byas 'jam tshugs la 'debs/ grong las la grwa pa 'grims pa byung na'ang mar zho re 'gel/ 'du khang du dge 'dun rnams chos spyod sogs la 'tshogs nas rtsed mo dang / zhal 'phros sogs tshod med byas pa byung na/ de 'phral chos khrims pas brgya phyag 'gel/ zhe ma zhun byas pa byung na las tshan kun mgrin gcig pas mar zho re 'gel/ gzhan yang lo ra lo thog 'joms pa/ sho mig mangs/ rdo bskor/ mda' rtsed/ mchong sogs mdzad par mi 'os pa byas byung na/ gong bzhin brgya phyag 'gel/ nad la phan pa'i phyir du 'du dgos byung na ma gtogs/ mang po 'tshogs tshe ngag la brtag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ ngag gi nyes pa la dran shes bzhin brten dgos pas/ rang rang gi grwa khang dang / bla ye sogs sa lkags lkugs su gnyis gsum nas mang du 'tshogs nas don med bag phebs phebs kyi cal col smra na/ 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo zhe sdang me ltar 'bar/ phrag dog rlung ltar du 'tshub nas rang la rang dbang med par phyogs cha sde rigs/ grwa tshang phan tshun/ rang rang gi bla ma'i zhen pho rus su bsam ste/ skyes bu dam pa dang / dge 'dun la sde rigs su bcad nas bskur ba 'debs pa sogs kyis mnar med du skye nges pa'i las bsog rang rang gi mched grogs phan tshun gyi gnas lugs brjod par bsam nas skyon brjod gleng bas chos sde de nyid du'ang 'khrug long gi rgyu byed pa sogs nyes pa mtha' yas pa zhig 'byung zhing / bdud dang po ngag la 'jug ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'byung po stobs chen gyi bar chad dang po ngag la 'jug pa yin pas/

tshe 'di'i snang ba bde bde/ bag phebs phebs la brten nas bdud kyis sems rgyud bslad/ de la brten nas dpon slob grogs mched phan tshun rtsem zol du 'gro ba dang / slob gnyer/ rim gro sgrig sogs g.yel du song nas 'thab rtsod snyung gzhi sogs mi dge ba 'byung nges yin pas/ de bzhin du ma song bar rang rang gi gnas su sems rnal du phab/ blo bla ma dkon mchog la ling bkal nas bag zon che bar mdzad pa gal che/ dpon slob grwa tshang dkrugs pa byung na/ nged la spyi chos kyis lan thong pa gyis/ de rigs la hor khrims kyi rtsa ra byas pa rang phan pa yin/ grwa pa nang du kha 'thab/ lag 'thab/ rma khrag pho ba sogs kyi rgya 'dre byas pa byung na/ 'di khar bla ma spyi chos rnams kyis 'phral du gtugs ngos/ bden brdzun brtags/ khrims med gnang che chung la dpags pa'i chad pa dran 'dzin babs thob re nged rang gi kha ltas khyab pa byed/ yang kha 'thab lag 'thab tsam la de khar bla ma spyi chos kyis chod pa byung na des 'thus rgyu yin/ rgyun pa'i chos spyod mdzad dgos/ 'jam tshugs la 'tshogs dus/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed song rjes/ gong ma lnga'i sku bstod yongs rdzogs/ der rjes sa lo'i sku bstod/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi sku bstod/ nged rang sku mched gsum dang rje mus chen gyi sku bstod/ yon tan tshad med ma bdag gi dus gsum dge ba sogs kyi smon lam/ der rjes dkar cha bzhi/ sems brtse ma/ der rjes gsol thug mchod grub 'phral/ gang gi sbyin pa sogs tshigs bcad/ bzlog pa tshar re/ byams smon tshar re mdzad/ mang ja'i chos spyod la/ sbyin bdag gi blo dang bstun sku rim dmigs bsal dgos pa byung na ma gtogs/ nged rang gi lag nas gtong ba'i dus ja bcu gnyis sogs mang ja'i rigs thams cad la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed song rjes/ rin chen sems bzung ma dang / byang chub sems ni rin po che sogs/

ja mchod skal bzang ma/ gsol ja mchod grub 'phral/ shes bya kun la ma gdangs dang bcas pa/ rab mdzes ma gdangs dang bcas pa/ rgya chen ma gdangs dang bcas pa/ lam 'bras phyag mchod maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ chos rgyal ma gdangs dang bcas pa/ sems brtse ma byams pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs sh+lau ka gcig gang gi blo gros ma/ zhi gdong ma/ bir bstod gsum re mos/ gong ma lnga'i sku bstod yongs rdzogs/ grags ldan kun tu sogs nas rong ston gyi bar/ rgya chen ma dang / rab mdzes ma tshigs bcad re re/ bdag chen ngag nas/ tshe nas/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa rnams kyi sku bstod tshigs bcad re re/ shes bya kun la ma/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma/ phun tshogs tshul khrims ma/ 'dzam gling che dgu ma gsum re mos/ 'gro ba'i mgon po ma dang / legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma gnyis re mos/ nged rang sku mched gsum gyi sku bstod sh+lau ka re re/ rje mus chen gyi sku bstod sh+lau ka re/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi sogs tshigs bcad gsum/ yon tan tshad med ma/ bdag gi dus gsum ma/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs tshigs bcad gsum/ gsol ja gsum pa'i steng du/ tshe gzungs tshar bcu gcig sher snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa tshar gsum/ 'gro la bde skyid ma/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa rnams mdzad/ chos spyod 'di rnams la dbu mdzad kyis sems khur bskyed de nan tan gyis bsgrub pa dang / de la 'dus pa'i tshogs kyis kyang le lo dang sgyid lug med par lus sems rtse gcig pa'i bstan pa dang sems can snying khongs su bcangs pa'i dad 'dun drag pos mgrin gcig tu mdzad 'tshal te/ dgon gnas gang du yang rgyun pa'i chos spyod 'di la res shor byung tshe/ phyogs der 'khrug long dang / rims nad sogs mi mthun pa'i rkyen sna tshogs 'byung ba myong grub legs pas khe nyen thugs la bzhag pa'i spang blang 'dzol med cis kyang mdzod/

rgyugs gnon byed dgos btsun gsar rnams dgon par slebs nas lo re'i khongs su chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen du mdzad pa'i chos spyod che phra thams cad blor chug pa dgos rgyu yin pas/ de bzhin gyi rgyugs gnon bla ma dang spyi chos kyi srub lus med pa byed pa dang / de bzhin du cho 'phrul gyi zla ba la/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / nged rang sku mched gsum gyi yum lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo gnyis kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dmigs pa'i kun rig sgrub mchod dang / yang sa ga zla ba la/ bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros de nyid kyi dgongs pa chos dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs dang / dge sding gi dus rim bstan phyir chen mo rnams la de dang de'i sgrub mchod gtor bzlog sogs ran skabs su so so'i cho ga'i tshig rigs rnams bla ma spyi chos dang bcas pa'i grwa pa drag zhan kun la chig rgyugs blangs ngos/ med pa rnams cho ga la yong du mi 'jug pa gal che/ rgyus gnon 'di rnams grub mtshams 'di la 'di 'dug gi gsal re nged rang la sleb pa gyis/ kun rig dang tshe dpag med sgrub mchod skabs/ dbu rgyan/ dar dpyang / rtsa bcings/ rdor dril sogs kyang grwa pa thams cad kyis cha tshang re bsnams dgos yin/ mdor na der bzhugs kyi dge 'dun bgres pa rnams kyis gzhon pa rnams la/ blang dor gyi gnas rnams mi shes pa gong phud/ shes pa dang len gyis bstan pa dgon gnas dang bcas pa snying khongs su bcangs pa'i legs slob nyes bcos tshul bzhin du bgyid pa dang / gzhon pa rnams kyis kyang dang len yang dag bgyis ngos mig ltos la phan pa'i bskur skyong go ma log pa'i spang blang 'dzol med mgo 'og tu lus tshud pa zhig so so nas gal che/

de ltar gong du phra rags smos pa rnams mthun phyogs rnams kun gyi thugs la bcangs/ phyag len la btab/ mi mthun phyogs rnams rgyang ring du dor nas/ bstan pa rin po che'i zhabs tog dang / gzhan skye 'gro mtha' dag gi rgyud la dge legs kyi dpal chen po thob pa'i ched du/ ched gnyer dang dos pa yang dag pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos rgyu legs/ bla ma dang spyi chos kyis kyang / phyogs cha/ nye ring / kun slong / le lo/ rang 'dod spangs/ ngo dga'/ las sla/ khur med ma yin pa'i grwa tshang gi spyi jus kho na la bsam dkon mchog dpang du btsugs/ bca' yig la cha bzhag pa'i 'chug med sra thang sems khur che ba rang zhig byed dgos/ yang bla ma spyi chos rnams kyi bsam pa skyon can la brten gong las 'gal ba'i grwa tshang ma snyoms pa sogs byas pa byung na/ dge 'dun bying rang gis nged la lan gsal sleb pa gyis/ bden brdzun brtags/ gzhung bsrangs pa'i kha lta dran 'dzin gtong zhing / yang bla ma dang spyi chos rnams kyis thad bzhin byas kyang ngan khog bcangs dgos med kyi bsnyad sko zhe mi nyan byas pa byung na/ 'di nas kha lta phyi lam khegs pa'i hor khrims gtong dgos 'char bas der ma song ba tha dad nas spang blang mdzad 'tshal/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir grwa tshang gi sgrig lugs mthun 'di gzhan las phan yon che zhing / bcur dag sgrig khyon yang shin tu dka' ba zhig yong gin 'dug pa nas/ chos lugs kyi khrims rkyang pas mi 'chur na/ rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gis dam pa'i chos 'di bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lugs gnyis kyi khrims gzhung bsrangs pa'i brjid nan ngos nas chos khrims rnam par dag pa'i dge legs chu bo'i rgyun lta bu zhig bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa kho nas dbang byas pa yin pas tha dad nas dgongs pa zhu/ dkor gyis bzi ba rang gis ma shes pa'i gyag khyer spyod rtsing byung na/

tshe 'di phyi gnyis med yong bas/ rang sems la rang gis bya ra btang grwa thabs 'grig pa rang zhig gal che/ de ltar bshad pa'i spang blang de rnams kyang / ngo lkog med pa zhig cis kyang gal che/ dngos phag byas na rang re so so skye bo rnams kyi khul du phag sub kyi re zhig sham sa yod kyang / sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa'i bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi thugs kyis khrel bar 'gyur zhing / de ltar gyur na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ring du byed pa yin te/ don 'di la dgongs nas mgon po byams pas/ 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las kyang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan/ /de dag rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /bdag ni mngon par gnas so zhes/ /de ltar shes nas ngo tsha dang / /gus dang 'jigs ldan de ltar gnas/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa drag zhan so so'i thugs la bzhag pa'i dkon mchog dbyings nas mi khrel ba'i bag yod kyi spyod pa la rgyun du gnas pa zhig mdzad 'tshal lo/ /'dir smras pa/ e ma gangs can khrod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya/ /gang der mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'jam dpal gyi/ /rnam sprul la la ngur smrig gos 'chang zhing / /la la gos dkar lcang los mdzes byas te/ /thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal srid 'dzin pa la/ /sa skya pa zhes 'gro la rab grags pa/ /gang gi skyes mchog dpal ldan 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /stobs ldan se chen rgyal pos legs bsten nas/ /shing sgo 'dzin pa'i bod yul chol kha gsum/ /dam chos yon du phul ba nas bzung ste/ /sa skya pa yi 'bangs su ma gyur su/ /de tshe mkha' la nyi zla rnam gnyis ltar/ /sa la mchod yon gnyis zhes cher grags shing / /rnam dag bstan pa phyogs bcur dar bas na/

/mkhas grub bye bas gangs can ljongs 'di khyab/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag gshegs pa'i rjes/ /bstan pa'i bdag po rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed srol 'dzin pa'i skyes chen du ma zhig /rim par byon nas bstan pa spel zhes thos/ /dus der yid srub stobs ldan 'ga' yi rgyus/ /dus mthar gyur pa'i snang tshul ston pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bsti gnas dam pa rnams/ /dus ngan mtshan gyi lhag mar nye bar byas/ /e ma de tshe sngags 'chang sprul ba'i sku/ /e ma mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpag yas des/ /e ma bdud rigs thams cad nyer bcom nas/ /e ma sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ /gang gi bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pas/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po'i bzhed srol rnams/ /gang yang gsar du dar ba'i dge mtshan la/ /gangs khrod 'di na ngo mtshar mi 'dzin su/ /de ltar mdo dang sngags kyi srol chen po/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i yang snying mchog /de kun dar zhing rgyas pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun/ /de nyid 'phel phyir bca' yig 'di byas so/ /'di la brten nas chos mthun dge 'dun tshogs/ /'di dang lhan cig phyogs der 'phel gyur nas/ /'di sbyar dge bas skal bzang dpyod ldan rnams/ /'di sogs legs bshad blta bas brel gyur cig /tshul 'di sa skya'i rje btsun gsung rab rnams/ /tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod blo gros can/ /tshul lugs phra mo'i rig gnas mthong tsam gyis/ /tshul bzhin shes pa sngags 'chang kho bos sbyar/ /chos grwa chen po bstan pa'i lhun po 'dir/ /rnal 'byor bdag la bsam ngan gdug rtsub can/ /byung ba srid na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srung rnams kyis myur du tshar chod cig /ngag dbang 'jam pa'i rdo rje mnyes byed cing / /mkhas kun dga' ba'i bstan bcos 'di brtsams pas/ /bsod nams rab rgyas grags pas yongs khyab cing / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor bzang por shog

/ces gdan sa bar pa dge sding 'dra 'dri chos rdzong bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi chos sde bstan pa'i lhun po'i bca' yig mdor bsdus 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po dang / sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku spyan snga kun dga' don 'grub la sogs te yongs 'dzin bslu med du ma'i zhabs sen rin po che dbang gi rgyal po spyi bo'i rgyan du bkod pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ shing pho byi ba'i lo zla ba drug pa'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis dge legs mchog tu gyur cig/ //shā sa na sa twam̐ ni bha wan+tu// bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig /shu bhaṃ ka l+yā ṇa war+dhan+tu// dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 a myes zhabs/ dge sding 'dra 'dri chos rdzong bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi chos sde bstan pa'i lhun po'i bca' yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
